overview.heading: What is on the Wetherspoons curry club?
overview.body:
The listed Curry Club selection includes chicken tikka masala, beef madras, chicken korma, two vegetable curries and two katsu options. The clearest distinction is between creamy, mildly spiced dishes and the fairly hot madras. Chicken tikka masala uses a tomato-based sauce enriched with cream, while chicken korma combines coconut and cream in an exceptionally mild, sweet sauce. Those differences are more useful when choosing than simply grouping both as chicken curries.

For plant-based choices, the Mangalorean roasted cauliflower and spinach curry uses a creamy coconut sauce. Sweet potato, chickpea and spinach curry has a gently spiced tomato and coconut sauce. Katsu chicken curry takes a different direction, pairing a panko-coated chicken escalope with a sweet, mildly spiced curry sauce.

overview.heading: How do curry portions and formats differ?
overview.body:
Curry Club dishes differ in format, but the supplied menu information does not give portion weights or comparable serving sizes. Traditional curries are described as coming with rice and naan. Chicken tikka masala and beef madras centre on pieces of meat in sauce, whereas the vegetable curries combine several plant ingredients. That helps you choose the texture and composition you want, without assuming one plate is larger than another.

The katsu dishes offer a clearer textural contrast. Katsu chicken curry features a sliced, panko-coated chicken escalope, while katsu Quorn nugget curry has eight nuggets on basmati rice with katsu sauce. Check the complete local dish description for accompaniments, particularly with katsu, rather than assuming every curry has an identical plate.

overview.heading: Which Curry Club meals include a drink?
overview.body:
A drink is often included with Curry Club at participating pubs, but the supplied information does not identify which individual dishes qualify. Thursday is the traditional club day, and special Thursday pricing is noted for this section. Check the local offer before deciding that chicken tikka masala, beef madras or either katsu option comes with a drink at the displayed price.

A food-and-drink deal is most useful when its eligible drink is something you actually want. Ask which drinks are covered and whether your chosen curry qualifies. For the Mangalorean roasted cauliflower and spinach curry or sweet potato, chickpea and spinach curry, also check the complete meal description if you want the whole order to match a plant-based diet.

overview.heading: Does the Curry Club menu change?
overview.body:
No seasonal dishes or rotating specials are identified in the supplied Curry Club information. The listed selection includes chicken korma, chicken tikka masala, beef madras, the two vegetable curries and both katsu dishes. Although the general section description mentions styles ranging from korma to vindaloo, no vindaloo appears in the item list. Do not plan an order around that general wording without checking your pub's menu.

Use the current local listing to confirm the selection rather than expecting an unlisted special. If your preferred curry is not shown, ask staff what is available before choosing a substitute. Korma and tikka masala offer mild alternatives to each other; the sweet potato curry provides a gently spiced plant-based option.

bestChoices.title: Best for a very mild curry
bestChoices.text: Chicken korma is the clearest choice for very mild spice. Its sweet sauce combines coconut and cream, making it a more suitable starting point than the fairly hot beef madras.

bestChoices.title: Best for a hotter curry
bestChoices.text: Beef madras suits diners seeking a bolder spice profile. Its fairly hot sauce contains tomatoes, chillies and earthy spices, giving it a different character from the creamy chicken curries.

bestChoices.title: Best for a vegan choice
bestChoices.text: Mangalorean roasted cauliflower and spinach curry carries a vegan tag and combines roasted vegetables with creamy coconut sauce. Check the complete local meal description so your accompaniments and any changes also fit your requirements.

bestChoices.title: Best for vegetarian katsu
bestChoices.text: Katsu Quorn nugget curry offers eight nuggets over basmati rice with sweet, mildly spiced katsu sauce. Choose it for the nugget format rather than a vegetable curry, but do not assume it is vegan.

bestChoices.title: Best for a rich curry
bestChoices.text: Chicken tikka masala combines marinated chicken with a creamy tomato-based sauce and mild spices. It is the supplied most-filling highlight, although portion weights and comparative calorie totals are not available here.

bestChoices.title: Best for mild plant-based flavour
bestChoices.text: Sweet potato, chickpea and spinach curry offers a gently spiced tomato and coconut sauce with both vegan and vegetarian tags. It is a useful alternative to chicken korma when you want mild flavour without choosing meat.

howToChoose.title: Start with your dietary needs
howToChoose.text: Choose from the labelled dishes first if you need a vegetarian or vegan meal. Both vegetable curries have vegan tags; the Quorn katsu has only a vegetarian tag. Raise allergy questions separately with staff.

howToChoose.title: Choose your spice level
howToChoose.text: Pick chicken korma for exceptionally mild spice, or chicken tikka masala for a mild, creamy tomato sauce. Beef madras is the fairly hot option; the sweet potato curry is gently spiced.

howToChoose.title: Compare the dish formats
howToChoose.text: Decide between a sauce-based curry and a katsu plate. Chicken katsu has a panko-coated escalope, while Quorn katsu uses nuggets over basmati rice. Check the full accompaniment listing before comparing the meals.

howToChoose.title: Check the complete deal
howToChoose.text: Confirm whether Thursday club pricing applies to your chosen curry and which drink, if any, is included. Compare the complete order with what you actually want, rather than choosing solely because an offer is mentioned.

howToChoose.title: Confirm before placing your order
howToChoose.text: Check the current local price, availability and any requested changes before ordering. If energy intake matters to you, consult the current nutritional listing for the complete meal rather than relying on a lightest-pick label.
